# CLOSURE REPORT TEMPLATE — `reports/R<n>-closure.md` (v0.2)

The report is generated **from files**, not from memory. The first screen carries the labels that qualify everything below it, and since v0.2 a tool writes it: the controller pastes it and does not compose it.

```markdown
# Round R<n> closure — <date>

<!-- paste reports/R<n>-firstscreen.md here VERBATIM (generated by `node pack/team/tools/round.mjs check . R<n>`).
     It carries: Label (MEASURED-CAPABLE | PROCESS REHEARSAL), allowed status, ledger count/head/verify, lint,
     isolation strength, independence, arms executed (parallel|sequential), Track B adapter + cognitive-hypothesis status,
     oracle mode, selection basis + margin, selection reproduced, integrity findings, and the 9-deliverable table.
     `round.mjs check . R<n> --closure reports/R<n>-closure.md` fails if any character of it was changed. -->

**Status:** <copy allowed_status from the first screen; CLOSED only if the tool allows it>

## The 9 required deliverables (already in the first screen; add notes only where a state needs explaining)
| # | Deliverable | Path | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Capability census with command proof | rounds/R<n>/CENSUS.json, census/*.txt | complete / partial (what is unknown) |
| 2 | Frozen round manifest + hidden oracle present | rounds/R<n>/round-manifest.json | frozen at ledger seq <k> |
| 3 | Ledger, verified | ledger/ledger.jsonl + verify output | PASS/FAIL |
| 4 | Arm results (all arms incl. NOT_RUN) with raw outputs | evidence/R<n>/*/ | <a> ran, <b> not run |
| 5 | Isolation report (canary scan + fence check + strength statement) | rounds/R<n>/isolation-report.json | clean / tainted: <arms> |
| 6 | Blind evaluation (files, rubric, per-arm scores) | rounds/R<n>/evaluation.json, evals/ | complete / partial |
| 7 | Selection + assimilation (track mains tagged, suites green) | selection.json, track-a@tag, track-b@tag | A: <tag> green? · B: <tag> green? |
| 8 | Learnings promoted (+ next-round plan) | track-*/learnings.jsonl, NEXT_ROUND_PLAN.md | <n> new, <m> refuted |
| 9 | Cockpit state + E2E results | cockpit/e2e-R<n>.txt | K0–K8: pass/fail list |

## What changed this round (≤ 10 lines, each with a path)

## Selection table
| Track | Component | Status | Winner / carried | Scores | Margin |
(from selection.json, verbatim)

## Track state

| main tag | | |

| accumulated suite: pass/total | | |
| cost this round (minutes / turns / tokens or "unknown") | | |

## Claims audit

## Not done / not claimed
Explicit list. An empty list is not acceptable.
```

## Rules for filling it

* Numbers come from files; each is traceable. "unknown" is a valid value.
* The first screen is a snapshot taken at CHECK time (its ledger head precedes `ROUND_CLOSED`). It is never edited by hand. If something on it is wrong, fix the underlying files, re-run `round.mjs check`, and paste again.
* If a deliverable is missing, the first screen says `MISSING`. `ROUND_CLOSED{status}` must equal the tool's `allowed_status` (`CLOSED` needs a verified ledger, evaluation, selection, ≥ 1 tagged track main, and no lint or integrity findings).
* "Not done / not claimed" must include at least: anything simulated, anything not independently evaluated, and anything the platform could not do.
* The controller ends the turn by printing the first screen of this report plus the decisions needed, then waits.
